acceptance_criteria.statement: A Task that neither links to a user story nor unblocks a Task that leads to one is refused, whatever kind of work it describes.
A Plan's page lists the stories its Tasks lead to, grouped by feature.
A reader can follow links from a Plan to a Task, through any Tasks it unblocks, to a story, and to that story's feature.
A change that would leave a Task with no path to a story is refused, and names the Tasks it would strand.

content.statement: As an architect, I can rely on every Task leading to a user story, directly or through the Tasks it unblocks, so all planned work traces back to why we are doing it and the chain of dependencies is clear.
content.title: Trace every Task to a user story

state.reason: Verified against the code and tests on 2026-11-02. A Task with no path to a story is refused, a stranding change names what it strands, and a reader can follow the chain.
